root_cause.text: The IRQ handler for dpaa2-switch failed to clear the interrupt status register when an out-of-bounds if_id was detected, causing the hardware to repeatedly fire the same interrupt and resulting in an interrupt storm.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the branch from "goto out;" (which skipped the interrupt clear) to "goto out_clear;" ensuring `dpsw_clear_irq_status()` is always called, as described in the commit message: "If an out-of-bounds if_id is detected, the interrupt status is not cleared. This may result in an interrupt storm. Clear the interrupt status after detecting an out-of-bounds if_id to avoid the problem."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix interrupt handler to clear interrupt status when invalid interface ID is received, avoiding repeated interrupts.
intent_record.what: Changed goto target from 'out' to 'out_clear' when an invalid interface ID is detected in the interrupt handler.
intent_record.how: On detection of an invalid if_id, the handler now jumps to 'out_clear' instead of 'out', ensuring that interrupt status is properly cleared before returning, preventing potential interrupt storms or improper state.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing IRQ status clearing on error paths by adding a cleanup label for goto targets.
intent_record.what: Added a label 'out_clear:' before the dpsw_clear_irq_status call, enabling goto branches to target this cleanup point.
intent_record.how: The label allows error paths to jump to a common point where the IRQ status is cleared, ensuring proper cleanup even when early exits occur.
